changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: Practice catalog installation state or workspace catalog tables are not present

changeSet.comment: Remove the installation marker only when a workspace has neither areas nor practices. Lock both catalog tables so the emptiness decision cannot race a concurrent catalog write.

changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: Configuration audit schema is not present

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Sparse instance overrides; absence means the bundled definition and order apply.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE curated_practice_override ( slug VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(128), applies_to VARCHAR(32), trigger_events JSONB, criteria TEXT, precompute_script TEXT, why_it_matters TEXT, what_good_looks_like TEXT, area_slug VARCHAR(64), position INTEGER, based_on_digest VARCHAR(64), retired_at TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE, created_at TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, version BIGINT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT ck_curated_practice_override_says_something CHECK (name IS NOT NULL OR retired_at IS NOT NULL OR position IS NOT NULL), CONSTRAINT ck_curated_practice_override_shape CHECK ( (name IS NULL AND applies_to IS NULL AND trigger_events IS NULL AND criteria IS NULL AND precompute_script IS NULL AND why_it_matters IS NULL AND what_good_looks_like IS NULL AND area_slug IS NULL AND based_on_digest IS NULL) OR (name IS NOT NULL AND applies_to IS NOT NULL AND trigger_events IS NOT NULL AND criteria IS NOT NULL) ), CONSTRAINT ck_curated_practice_override_applies_to CHECK (applies_to IS NULL OR applies_to IN ('PULL_REQUEST', 'ISSUE', 'CONVERSATION_THREAD')), CONSTRAINT ck_curated_practice_override_trigger_events CHECK (trigger_events IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(trigger_events) = 'array'), CONSTRAINT ck_curated_practice_override_position CHECK (position IS NULL OR position >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_curated_practice_override_based_on CHECK (based_on_digest IS NULL OR based_on_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') );
CREATE TABLE curated_area_override ( slug VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(128), description TEXT, position INTEGER, icon VARCHAR(64), color VARCHAR(32), based_on_digest VARCHAR(64), retired_at TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE, created_at TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, version BIGINT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT ck_curated_area_override_says_something CHECK (name IS NOT NULL OR retired_at IS NOT NULL OR position IS NOT NULL), CONSTRAINT ck_curated_area_override_shape CHECK ( name IS NOT NULL OR (description IS NULL AND icon IS NULL AND color IS NULL AND based_on_digest IS NULL) ), CONSTRAINT ck_curated_area_override_position CHECK (position IS NULL OR position >= 0), CONSTRAINT ck_curated_area_override_based_on CHECK (based_on_digest IS NULL OR based_on_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') );

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE curated_area_override; DROP TABLE curated_practice_override;

changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: Workspace practice revisions already contain complete definitions

changeSet.comment: Make a complete immutable revision the authoritative current definition for every workspace practice.

changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: Workspace areas already record their catalog origin

changeSet.comment: Record where a workspace's areas came from, and track per workspace whether its copies have been matched back to the catalog. Provenance is a per-workspace fact: an instance can hold workspaces seeded long before the catalog existed alongside ones created after it.
